services.desc: We offer a full schedule of CrossFit classes here at CFUS, carefully programmed each week to help members continually improve their strength, conditioning, skills, and overall capacity. Each one-hour class offers lots of variety, but the through line is always quality. Note that we require previous CrossFit experience to drop in to a class. For those interested in just getting started, see our on-ramp program for more details. A - Back squat1 x 6 @ RPE 82 x 4 @ RPE 81x 2-4 @ same weight or heavier than previous
